decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.
Condition : 3 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for a betting office  purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 10am to 9.30pm summer times and 10am to 5pm in winter times.

Condition : 5 - 5.	The use hereby permitted for commercial shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against internally generated airborne and impact sound to the residential accommodation above has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 6 - 6.	The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme for the control of noise from mechanical plant including details of sound attenuation has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.
description: Change of use from newsagents shop (A1) to Betting shop (A2).
